articles.title: Stromausfall Berlin: S-Bahnen in Berliner Südwesten fahren nach Stromausfall wieder
articles.teaser: Die Berliner Strombetriebe haben die Stromversorgung in drei betroffenen S-Bahnhöfen wieder hergestellt. Weiterhin sind 25.500 Menschen im Berliner Südwesten ohne Strom.
articles.image_title: Stromausfall Berlin: BERLIN, GERMANY - JANUARY 4: A police line at the entrance to the closed Mexicoplaz S-Bahn train station, during power outage, following an arson attack on power cables on January 4, 2026 in Berlin, Germany. The attack on the cables happened at a bridge crossing the Teltow Canal caused a blackout affecting approximately 45,000 residents as well as local businesses, hospitals and nursing homes in southwestern Berlin. The Stromnetz Berlin utility company has since restored power to approximately 7,000 residents but others will likely have to wait much longer to be reconnected . According to police, the perpetrators set fire to the cables early Saturday morning, the incident is similar to a previous attack on the city's electricity infrastructure in 2025. (Photo by Omer Messinger/Getty Images)
